fields.title: 10 Example - Both Time And Space
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 10 Example - Both Time And Space — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. Recreates a classic tune with multi-routed multi-scene modulation. Filters: lowpass OB-Xd 24 dB, lowpass Cutoff Warp. Oscillators: Modern, Twist, Alias. Effects: Flanger, Airwindows, Delay, Combulator.

fields.title: 09 Example - Crossfading Oscillators
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 09 Example - Crossfading Oscillators — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. Demonstrates a crossfade between three oscillators using the square root power law. Filters: lowpass OB-Xd 24 dB. Oscillators: Modern, Twist. Effects: Flanger, Delay, Airwindows.

fields.title: 11 Example - Reich - Piano Phase
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 11 Example - Reich - Piano Phase — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. The first pattern from Steve Reich's classic for 2 pianos. To hear it, simply set Surge XT to Latch play mode and wait until the phasing starts. Enjoy! Filters: lowpass OB-Xd 24 dB. Oscillators: Sine. Effects: Spring Reverb.

fields.title: 07 The Prelude
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 07 The Prelude — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. We explore the Prelude section of the Formula modulator. Oscillators: Twist, String.

fields.title: 01 A Simple Formula
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 01 A Simple Formula — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. The most basic example of a Formula modulator. Creates a simple square-to-saw modulator using some basic Lua code. Filters: lowpass OB-Xd 24 dB. Oscillators: Modern.

fields.title: 08 Quis Modulatiet Ipsos Modulates
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 08 Quis Modulatiet Ipsos Modulates — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. We talk about how the Formula modulator can interact with other modulation sources Oscillators: Sine.

fields.title: 12 A Slew Limiter
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 12 A Slew Limiter — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. Show how to use block size, sample rate, and state to implement a simple up-down slew limiter controlled by the macros. Oscillators: Sine.

fields.title: 02 Interacting With LFO Parameters
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 02 Interacting With LFO Parameters — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. Shows how to use Deform and Amplitude LFO parameters to adjust your formula modulator in unexpected ways. Oscillators: Classic.

fields.title: 03 The Init Function And State
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 03 The Init Function And State — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. Demonstrate the init() function of the Formula modulator and show how state is preserved across calls to process() and after calls from init(). Filters: lowpass Diode Ladder. Oscillators: Modern. Effects: Airwindows.

fields.title: 06 Macros And Voice Parameters
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 06 Macros And Voice Parameters — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. Wherein we show how to use macros instead of envelopes, and parameters of your voice if you are a Voice LFO. Filters: lowpass OB-Xd 24 dB. Oscillators: Modern.

fields.title: 04 Vector Valued Formulae
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 04 Vector Valued Formulae — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. In this tutorial, we explain how vector Formula modulator works with the Surge modulation system. Filters: lowpass Cutoff Warp. Oscillators: Classic.

fields.title: 05 The Envelope And Its Parameters
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 05 The Envelope And Its Parameters — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. We show how to use LFO EG as adjustable inputs to the Formula modulator, rather than an actual envelope applied to the LFO output. Oscillators: Sine. Effects: Flanger.

fields.title: 13 Duophony
fields.author: Surge Synth Team
fields.text: 13 Duophony — a Formula Modulator patch by Surge Synth Team. Uses the slew limiter built into the Formula Prelude, in order to make a duophonic patch with independent high/low voice portamento controls. Filters: lowpass 24 dB, highpass 24 dB. Oscillators: Window. Effects: Phaser, Reverb 2, Flanger.

fields.title: Bassoon
fields.author: JV
fields.text: Bassoon — a Winds patch by JV. Plays well using Breath/Expression. Like the real instrument, you need to hit a (fairly wide) sweet spot. To play the highest notes in the instrument's range, you need to increase 'Overblow', or set 'Higher modes' high and adjust your playing style. With thanks to Andreya [SST] for technical troubleshooting. If you want bass notes to speak better, then enable all the modulations of 'Latest Key' and use Breath control to avoid the clicks on legato note changes. Filters: effect filter Comb +, lowpass K35, highpass 24 dB. Oscillators: Modern. Effects: Resonator, EQ, Reverb 2, Airwindows.

fields.title: Cor Anglais
fields.author: JV
fields.text: Cor Anglais — a Winds patch by JV. You might find this Cor Anglais is not easy to keep within its sweet spot. It can be unstable and inconsistent. Very high notes need pre-activating with a hard blow, or movement from a lower note. Try overblowing and other techniques. Filters: effect filter Comb +, lowpass K35, highpass 24 dB. Oscillators: Modern. Effects: Resonator, EQ, Reverb 2, Airwindows.

fields.title: Noisy Synth Kick
fields.author: John Valentine
fields.text: Noisy Synth Kick — a Percussion patch by John Valentine. Synthy kick drum with high-frequency hiss. From the late 1980s. Centered on note C5. You can use this as basis for many parts of the drumkit. Macros add noise, snare, distorted kicks, reverb tails. Enable FX for more. Filters: lowpass Legacy Ladder, bandpass 12 dB, lowpass 12 dB, lowpass OB-Xd 24 dB. Oscillators: Wavetable, S&H Noise, String. Effects: Airwindows, Delay, Reverb 1, Phaser, Reverb 2.

fields.title: Tongue Drum
fields.author: John Valentine
fields.text: Tongue Drum — a Percussion patch by John Valentine. - Comes with Py12 tuning. Switch off 'Tune' for ET12. - Resonates in the range C4 to Eb5, but you can play any note. - Resonance above 40% starts to intermodulate notes. - Harmonics will cause higher resonances. - Note length is how long your finger is on the drum. Quick taps give longer rings. - If playing consistent arpeggios, set polyphony to arpeggio length, to help notes cancel on re-strike. Filters: effect filter Comb +, highpass 24 dB. Oscillators: FM3, Alias. Effects: Resonator, Combulator, Airwindows, EQ, Chorus, Reverb 2.
